idea-plugin.name: CodeBridge Runtime
idea-plugin.description:
Runs VS Code extensions as ordinary IntelliJ features, in the real VS Code extension host, which comes with the plugin. You don't need VS Code or Node.js installed.

On its own it runs only the extensions other plugins bundle: install a plugin made from a VS Code extension and this comes with it. To browse and install VS Code extensions yourself, and to use a project's .vscode folder, install CodeBridge.

Remote development (split mode) is supported: the UI stays on your machine and extensions run where the project lives. Windows on ARM is not supported.
